summary.en: Derive expression types, distinguish static and dynamic checks, and insert only the conversions allowed by a small language.
summary.bn: কোন টাইপের সঙ্গে কোন অপারেশন চলে, তা তুমি নিয়ম দিয়ে যাচাই করবে এবং দরকারি কনভার্শন চিনবে।

notes: Python programs use the standard library and were executed with Python 3.12.14.

examples.title: Derive numeric, Boolean and array types
examples.explanationHtml: The first three expressions derive real, bool and int; the remaining expressions violate explicit source rules.

examples.title: Check every scalar assignment conversion
examples.explanationHtml: Only identity and int-to-real assignments are implicit; all other scalar pairs are rejected.

practice.title: Describe composite types
practice.statementHtml: Give type expressions for ten real fees and a two-real-argument comparison function.
hints: Include array size and ordered function parameters.
practice.answerHtml:
A type expression builds a type from basic types and constructors. For arrays, include the index range or length and the element type. For functions, record the ordered parameter types and the return type. Merely writing function or array leaves out information needed to check a use.

Types of marks-related declarations
Declaration ideaType expressionMeaning
Whole markintOne integer value
Pass flagboolOne truth value
Ten real feesarray(10, real)Ten elements, each real
Convert mark to gradefunction(int → int)One int parameter, int result
Compare two real valuesfunction((real, real) → bool)Two ordered real parameters
Pointer to integerpointer(int)Address of an int under the source rules

Two independently written array(10, real) expressions can be structurally equal. A language using name equivalence may instead require the same declared type name. State which rule applies before deciding whether record or array assignments are legal. Our array examples use structural equality of length and element type.

A typing environment Γ maps names to declared types. The judgement Γ ⊢ e : T means that expression e has type T under those declarations. You do not need the expression's numeric result to derive its type. That is why a compiler can reject many errors without running the user's program.

practice.title: Derive a comparison type
practice.statementHtml: With marks:int and bonus:real, derive marks + bonus < 60 and assignment to passed:bool.
hints: Type the leaves before their parents.
practice.answerHtml:
Let Γ contain marks:int and bonus:real. Check marks + bonus < 60 from the leaves upwards. This is a static derivation: no particular mark or bonus value is required. Each parent uses the types already derived for its children.

Complete derivation for marks + bonus < 60
StepExpressionInput typesResult and action
1marksΓ(marks) = intint
2bonusΓ(bonus) = realreal
3marks + bonusint, realreal; convert marks to real
460Integer literalint
5(marks + bonus) < 60real, intbool; convert 60 to real
6Assign comparison to passed:boolbool → boolAllowed, identity conversion

If you assign the sum to an int destination instead, the final assignment is rejected. The addition itself remains well typed. Keep the location of the error precise: an invalid destination conversion is different from an invalid operand combination.

practice.title: Check calls and indexes
practice.statementHtml: Check scores[1], scores[True], scores[5], grade(marks), grade(bonus) and compare(40,50.5) under the declarations in the lesson.
hints: Distinguish the index type from its bounds.
practice.answerHtml:
Let scores have type array(3, int). Indexing scores[1] produces int because the index has type int. Indexing scores[True] is rejected in our language. Indexing scores[5] has a valid index type but an invalid constant bound; that is an additional check, not a reason to confuse type and value.

Checking a call and an array access
UseTypes foundCheckDecision
scores[1]array(3,int), intInteger indexResult int
scores[True]array(3,int), boolIndex must be intReject
scores[5]array(3,int), intConstant 5 outside 0..2Reject by bounds analysis
grade(marks), grade: int → intArgument intParameter intResult int
grade(bonus), grade: int → intArgument realNo implicit narrowingReject
compare(40, 50.5)int, realParameters real, realConvert first argument; result bool

The executable type model checks the type of an array index, not its runtime bounds. A full compiler can separately reject a known bad constant index. When the index depends on input, a runtime bounds check may still be needed even after static type checking succeeds.

practice.title: Choose the check stage
practice.statementHtml: Classify numeric-operand, integer-index, input-bound and zero-divisor checks as static or dynamic.
hints: Ask whether a declaration gives enough information.
practice.answerHtml:
A static check happens before execution, using declarations and program structure. A dynamic check happens while an operation is executed, using actual values or runtime type information. A dynamically typed language can still detect syntax errors before running. A statically typed language can still need runtime checks.

Compile-time knowledge versus runtime knowledge
QuestionKnown from types alone?Suitable check
Is marks + flag numeric?Yes; flag is boolStatic type error
Does scores receive an integer index?Yes with declarationsStatic type check
Is a user-provided index within bounds?Usually noDynamic bounds check
Is the divisor zero for this input?Usually noDynamic value check
Does a literal assignment narrow real to int?YesStatic conversion rule

The difference matters for diagnostics. A static error can point at an expression that would never execute. A dynamic error occurs only when execution reaches the operation. Neither style means that all incorrect programs can be recognised in advance.

quiz.prompt: In this language, what is the type of int + real?
quiz.explanation: The integer operand is converted to real before addition.

quiz.prompt: Which implicit assignment is permitted here?
quiz.explanation: The stated rules permit numeric widening but reject narrowing and Boolean mixing.

quiz.prompt: What does Γ supply in a typing judgement?
quiz.explanation: The environment lets the rule look up each identifier's declared type.

quiz.prompt: Why must the literal checker test bool before int in Python?
quiz.explanation: Host inheritance must not accidentally change source-language arithmetic rules.

quiz.prompt: Which fact may require a runtime check for scores[i]?
options: Whether scores was declared an array
The element type in the declaration
Whether the input index is in bounds
quiz.explanation: A valid integer type does not guarantee a value inside the array.

quiz.prompt: What type expression describes ten real elements?
quiz.explanation: The array constructor records both the length and the element type.

options: A conversion requested in source code
quiz.explanation: A programmer-written conversion differs from an implicit coercion.

quiz.prompt: Which source expression is invalid under our numeric rule?
quiz.explanation: Boolean values are separate from numeric values in the stated source language.

quiz.prompt: Under structural equivalence, what must equal array types agree on here?
quiz.explanation: The constructor arguments determine structural equality for these arrays.

quiz.prompt: Why might a typed AST include int-to-real nodes?
options: To preserve conversion decisions for later phases
To remove parentheses from source text
To postpone all errors until execution
quiz.explanation: Explicit conversion nodes tell later phases which numeric operation to generate.

keyPoints.en: A type describes which values and operations an expression permits.
keyPoints.bn: টাইপ দেখে বোঝো এক্সপ্রেশনে কোন মান আর অপারেশন চলবে।

keyPoints.en: Static checking uses declarations before execution.
keyPoints.bn: প্রোগ্রাম চালানোর আগে ঘোষণা দেখে স্ট্যাটিক চেক করো।

keyPoints.en: Dynamic checks can still be necessary after successful type checking.
keyPoints.bn: টাইপ মিলে গেলেও চলার সময় অ্যারের বাউন্ড চেক লাগতে পারে।

keyPoints.en: An implicit conversion must follow the source language rules.
keyPoints.bn: কম্পাইলার নিজের মতো কনভার্শন করবে না, ভাষার নিয়ম মানবে।

keyPoints.en: Array index types and array index bounds are different checks.
keyPoints.bn: ইনডেক্সের টাইপ আর ইনডেক্স সীমার মধ্যে আছে কি না, আলাদা করে দেখো।
